svg.text: Masking in the browser (ADR-0003), the pipeline of queues (ADR-0005), statuses and identifiers (ADR-0006). Alternatives are alt frames (success path in green); red ✗ = state after an infrastructure failure. SLA targets are proposals (p95).
Mask in the browser · measured: 6–8 s/page on a phone, 11–28 s/page on a 2017 laptop
1. the user picks the file; originalSha256 = SHA-256 of the original (several photos: of their sorted hashes)
2. GET /documents?originalSha256={h} (a hash only; before any masking)
3. SELECT Document WHERE userId=@me AND originalSha256=@h
5. "Imported already": open it, or "import as a new version" (U9); nothing is masked or sent
7. render, OCR, zone masking, leak check; the user approves the masked pages; pack them into a ZIP
✗ nothing was sent: no state anywhere, the user starts again
Browser closed here: nothing is lost on the server,
because nothing was sent. The original stays on the device.
8. POST /documents (application/zip: pages/{pageSha}.png + manifest.json { order[], keptRegions[], originalSha256 })
✗ network error: nothing stored, or stored and the UI does not know it; the retry lands in "uploaded already" below
9. limits: ≤ 50 MB, ≤ 200 pages, PNG ≤ 25 MP from the header; today's imports < 10 (else 429). Unzip in memory: stored entries only, names from the manifest, PNG only; recompute page hashes
11. SELECT Document WHERE userId=@me AND originalSha256=@h
✗ SQL paused: waits for it to wake up; on timeout 503, UI retries
12. 200 { docId, verId, status } (existing document; UI offers to open it)
13. docId, verId = new UUIDv7 (Guid.CreateVersion7), generated before any write
✗ API dies here: orphan ZIP, no row; the lifecycle deletes it after 24 h
15. TX: INSERT Document (UNIQUE userId + originalSha256), Version(Uploaded); COMMIT
✗ rollback: no row, orphan ZIP as above; 500, UI retries. Unique violation (parallel retry): 200 with the existing document
16. send check: CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId }
✗ API dies after COMMIT: Uploaded without a message; the sweeper sends it
✗ response lost: the document exists, the UI finds it in the list
[uploaded already: a retry, or another tab, since the hash check]
[invalid: not a stored ZIP, not PNG, unknown name, page hash ≠ manifest]
Browser closed after 202: the server carries on.
Next visit: the list shows the current status.
Checker · target: Blocked, or handed to the extractor, within 1 min of the upload
18. CheckRequested { userId, docId, verId } + deliveryCount; the lock is renewed while working
✗ checker down: message waits in the queue; status stays Uploaded
21. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId } (again; the extractor is idempotent)
[clean ZIP exists: the earlier try passed it, maybe crashed before reporting]
[no clean ZIP: the earlier try blocked or failed it and reported it, or the document was deleted]
23. verify page hashes, shape check, OCR + zone rules (in memory, nothing stored)
25. send extract: ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId }
✗ crash before sending: redelivered, the resume alt sends it
26. send status: Blocked { userId, docId, verId, regions[]: {page,x,y,w,h,rule} } (U4)
27. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: integrity }
[blocked: ink outside the kept regions, or personal data found by OCR]
[broken: a page hash or PNG does not match]
✗ not deleted: the lifecycle removes it after 24 h
[incoming ZIP missing: an earlier try got this far]
29. abandon: Service Bus delivers it again later
30. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: check_error }
[an exception (OCR error, out of memory caught) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt finds the work done
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it (about 30 s + cold start); the event waits
34. UPDATE Version SET Blocked + regions | Failed + reason WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded
35. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Extractor · target: PendingReview within 3 min of the upload
37. ExtractRequested { userId, docId, verId } + deliveryCount; the lock (5 min at most) is renewed while working
✗ extractor down: waits; status stays Uploaded. Lock not renewed: a second delivery runs in parallel; the first status wins
40. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId } (from the saved results; no DI, no OpenAI)
43. build an image-only PDF of all pages in memory (never stored)
✗ DI down or 429: see the error alt below
45. { pages[]: words, lines, tables, bbox } (page number → pageSha by manifest order)
46. chat(words with ids, tables of the batch, JSON schema)
✗ OpenAI down or 429: see the error alt below
47. { results[]: name, value, unit, range + the word ids of each; dates as local time }
48. validate: pydantic schema; each field equals its words (word check); dates get their zone and offset in code; if invalid: one retry with the errors
[for each batch of pages (5 to start; tuned with evals)]
49. PUT text/{userId}/{docId}/{verId}.json { extraction, pages[]: words, fragments[], documentDates[], results[] } If-None-Match: *
✗ crash: redelivered, the first alt resends. 412 (a parallel run wrote it first): keep theirs, so the blob always matches the first Extracted
50. send status: Extracted { userId, docId, verId }
51. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: no_results }
52. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_invalid }
[all batches valid, at least one result]
[valid, but no results: not a lab result]
[clean ZIP missing: the document was deleted meanwhile]
[results already saved: an earlier try crashed before reporting]
54. send status: Failed { userId, docId, verId, reason: extract_error }
[DI or OpenAI error (429, 5xx, timeout) and deliveryCount < 5]
✗ not completed (crash): delivered again; the first alt resends from the saved results
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it; the event waits
✗ blob missing (document deleted): complete and ignore
58. TX: UPDATE Version SET PendingReview WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded; if 1 row: INSERT Extraction(model, prompt and dictionary versions), LabResult[] (dates as JSON, CollectedAt); COMMIT
✗ SQL error: rollback; abandon, delivered again
59. complete; the UI sees PendingReview on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, a superseded version, or the document was deleted]
✗ API asleep: the queue scale rule wakes it (about 30 s + cold start); the event waits
62. UPDATE Version SET Failed + reason WHERE verId AND status=Uploaded
63. complete; the UI sees the new status on its next poll
[0 rows: a duplicate, an old version, or the document was deleted]
Progress in the UI · polling every 3 s while the page is open
✗ API asleep: waits for the cold start
66. SELECT Version.status, regions WHERE userId=@me AND docId
67. { verId, status: Uploaded | Blocked | PendingReview | Approved | Failed, reason?, regions? }
Browser closed: the server carries on.
Next visit: the list shows the status, PendingReview opens the review.
Always: the sweeper · every 5 min while the API is awake; a cron scale rule wakes the API once a day
68. SELECT Version WHERE status=Uploaded AND updatedAt < now() − 10 min
69. send CheckRequested again (ExtractRequested for a version made from a checked ZIP, U9); receivers are idempotent
70. UPDATE SET resends = resends + 1, updatedAt = now()
A pipeline down for more than about 30 minutes ends its imports in Failed (timeout).
plaintext original or unmasked personal data
note: a fact, e.g. the user closes the browser
✗ if this step fails: state of the system
